description: This file defines extension methods for the IConnectionBuilder interface to add TLS (Transport Layer Security) functionalities for server and client connections in Orleans. It also contains an internal method for error handling related to missing private keys in certificates.

classes.name: TlsConnectionBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to configure TLS for Orleans connection builders.

methods.name: UseServerTls
methods.description: Sets up TLS server-side middleware on an IConnectionBuilder with specified options.

methods.name: UseClientTls
methods.description: Sets up TLS client-side middleware on an IConnectionBuilder with specified options.

methods.name: ThrowNoPrivateKey
methods.description: Internal method that throws an ArgumentException when an X509Certificate2 does not contain a private key.
